senses.gloss: to feel heavy, feel pain. Y. Sabb. IV, 8ᶜ top החוֹשֵׁשׁ אזנו he who has ear-ache.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:1">Esth. R. to I, 1</cite> (play on <he>אח̇ש̇ור̇וש</he>) who ever thinks of him <he>ח̇וֹשֵֹׁשׁ את ר̇אש̇ו</he> gets a head-ache; a. e.—(Mostly with <cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2">Cant. R. to V, 2</cite> <he>אם חושש … בראשו</he> if one of the twins has a head-ache; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:2">Pes. I, 2</cite> <he>אין חוֹשְׁשִׁין שמא וכ׳</he> we do not take into consideration that perhaps a weasel &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:24">Tosef. Ḥull. III, 24</cite> <he>ואין ח׳ שמא של וכ׳</he> and we need not hesitate to use them for fear that they may be eggs of &c.; <cite ref="Chullin 63b">Ḥull. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>אין ח׳ לא משום וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 16:7">Sabb. XVI, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 22:3">XXII, 3</cite> <he>חוֹשְׁשַׁנִי לו מחטאת</he> I am afraid he has committed a sin which requires a sin-offering to atone for; a. fr.
